luau: Luau allocates GC objects from per-size-class pages, so a fresh mlua Luau state reports about 436 KB from Lua::used_memory(), of which about 182 KB is resident before our call function, limits, and sandbox are added (separate diagnostic in diag/luau-mem, 1,000 states).
boa: boa_gc collects with stop-the-world mark and sweep: the median batch hides the pauses, so the mean and the CPU per call run well above the median, and the slowest batch includes a pause.
steel: A Steel session deep-clones its bootstrap kernel and compiles its prelude, so sessions are large and slow to create: the memory phase stops at its growth budget well before 1,000 sessions, and the start phase runs only as many creates as fit its time budget.
roto: The tool-call loop is compiled machine code making three direct native calls per iteration, so it measures Roto's FFI and native-call cost rather than an interpreter.
